status.observeTitle: Колачлау һәм кагыйдәләрне үтәү — аерым төшенчәләр
status.observeDescription: Сәясәт караламалары алдан карау өчен генә. Кушымталарны маршрутлау Apply төймәсенә ачыктан-ачык басканнан соң Mihomo эчендә генә кулланыла. Башкарыла торган файлларны системаның үз чаралары белән тыю өчен ОС провайдеры расланган һәм актив булырга тиеш. Проксиның эшләве тоташуны аварияле өзүне яки бөтен система трафигын маршрутлауны гарантияләми.
status.separateControls: Үзәк маршрутлавы · Система тыюлары · Караламаларны алдан карау
status.loadingFailed: Could not load the network workspace
status.storageReadOnly: Saved workspace could not be loaded. Original data is preserved; editing and recording controls are read-only.

capabilities.title: Effective capabilities
capabilities.note: A running proxy or TUN does not establish these native security guarantees.

settings.title: Local history
settings.recordingDescription: Өстәл кушымтасы процессы эшләгәндә генә, теләк буенча җирле тарих языла: үзәкнең мизгеллек күчермәләре һәм расланган күзәтү провайдеры вакыйгалары. Чыганакларның исәпләгечләре аерым, колачлавы тулы түгел. Үзәк язмалары төркемләп саклана; көтмәгәндә чыгу соңгы 10 секунд мәгълүматын югалтырга мөмкин. Яздыру яңадан кабызылганда, ул сүндерелгән чакта җыелган система вакыйгалары кертелми.
settings.privacy: History contains app paths and network destinations. It is not sent to a remote service. Disabling recording stops new samples; clear history separately to delete saved records.
settings.limitWarning: Reducing these limits may delete old records on save.

policies.title: Draft firewall and routing policy
policies.description: Rules can be saved and evaluated against synthetic inputs. Saving a draft does not block, prompt or redirect real connections.
policies.applicationHint: Exact executable path; leave blank for any application.
policies.invalidJson: The draft must contain valid JSON.
policies.portsHint: Comma-separated ports; leave blank for any port.
policies.invalidDraft: The policy must include firewallRules, routeRules and defaults.
policies.discardDescription: This restores the last saved draft. No live network policy will change.
policies.staleDraft: A newer saved draft (generation {{latestGeneration}}) is available. Your edits from generation {{generation}} were kept. Saving cannot overwrite the newer draft. Discard unsaved edits to load it.

preview.title: Policy preview
preview.description: This evaluates saved rules only. It neither sends traffic nor creates a real firewall prompt.
preview.invalidPort: Enter a destination port between 1 and 65535.
preview.routeBlocked: Not evaluated while permission is blocked or unresolved.

history.title: Observed core connections
history.coverage: Core-only, sampled and incomplete. No direct-traffic coverage or native verdicts. Disappearing from a snapshot is not proof of an exact close time.
history.empty: No saved observations. Enable recording in Settings to collect partial connection history.
history.clearDescription: This permanently removes stored observations from this application's history. Recording, if enabled, continues with new samples. It does not close connections or remove proxy profiles.
history.exportDescription: Exported data excludes app identity, destinations and rule payloads, but contains timing, traffic counts and completeness metadata. Choose where to save the local JSON file.
history.retentionNote: Records may be pruned at the retention or record limit.

imports.description: Imported permissions remain drafts until a supported native adapter is available.
imports.replaceWarning: This replaces all firewall rules in the unsaved draft. Routing rules are preserved. Review rejected rules; nothing is saved or enforced until you save the draft policy.
imports.exportWarning: This file can contain application paths and destinations. Policy defaults, mode and generation are not transferable. Routing rules are not exported as firewall permissions. Review omissions before saving.
imports.tooLarge: Rule files must be 2 MiB or smaller.
